latestVersion.changelog:
Music Free — Remove Music, Keep Voice (v1.0.0)

- Initial release: Quickly remove background music from videos while preserving vocals using AI, with zero editing software required.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB.
- Connects to a cloud backend and manages sessions automatically (100 free credits/7 days for new users).
- Processes jobs in 30–60 seconds; delivers 1080p MP4 by default.
- Provides clear instructions and workflow for uploading, editing, exporting, and checking credits or status.
- Ideal for creators who need to remove licensed music before publishing.
